Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the quick chat yesterday. As discussed, our infra and infra security leads want a hands-on technical review before we sign off on the PoC kickoff. Key asks:
- Walkthrough of request routing and fallback behavior when we hit publish-time capacity limits
- KV-cache warmup approach for our 16k-seq workloads
- What telemetry we can expect in the first 30 days (traces, token-level cost)

Can we schedule a 60–75 minute technical deep-dive this week or early next? Prefer mornings PST. Olivia and I are available Thu/Fri mornings, but Samir from our current provider can only do afternoons PT — we can loop him in for the later part of the session if helpful.

Also attaching our current config export (small sanitized version) so you can spot anything obvious ahead of time.

Appreciate it — Jordan
